name: HeroWalkIn
_intent: Confident, weighty hero entrance stride: chest up, slight forward lean from the hips, shoulders counter-turning and rolling a little, arms swinging with intent (fists loosely closed, elbow bends on the forward swing), heel strike and toe-off on every step, only the natural stride bob.
_reference: human walk cycle (heel strike, loading, mid-stance, heel rise, toe-off, swing); 2 steps per 1.1333 s, root travel 2.3871 studs per cycle (2.1063 studs/s)

_walk.how: move the HumanoidRootPart forward at speed_studs_per_s while this loops
